body:
I walk along the beach, my eyes scanning the horizon for any sign of life or movement. Suddenly, I spot a figure standing near the water's edge, gazing out at the sea in silent contemplation. As they turn around, their expression shifts from one of peace to one of confusion when they see me. 

My chest tightens as I realize this person must be the cause of the strange sight. My face flushes with anger but I control myself, taking a deep breath before addressing them.
